title: Zoning map change for 108-05 68th Road, Forest Hills
summary: This rezones a property at 108-05 68th Road in Forest Hills, Queens from an R1-2A to an R7A district. The change would allow a seven-story mixed-use building with about 33 apartments, including eight income-restricted units, and 11,500 square feet of community facility space. The Council held a public hearing on October 6, 2026.
